from manim import *
import numpy as np

class WalkingAgent3(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#87CEEB"
        
        # Scenery
        ground = Line(LEFT * 10, RIGHT * 10, color=BLACK, stroke_width=6).shift(DOWN * 2)
        
        clouds = VGroup()
        for i in range(5):
            cloud = VGroup(
                Circle(radius=0.5, color=WHITE, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1).shift(LEFT*0.3),
                Circle(radius=0.7, color=WHITE, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1),
                Circle(radius=0.4, color=WHITE, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1).shift(RIGHT*0.4 + DOWN*0.2)
            ).shift(UP * np.random.uniform(1.5, 3) + RIGHT * (i * 4 - 8))
            clouds.add(cloud)
            
        def update_clouds(mob, dt):
            for c in mob:
                c.shift(LEFT * dt * 1.5)
                if c.get_x() < -8:
                    c.shift(RIGHT * 16)
                    
        clouds.add_updater(update_clouds)
        
        self.add(ground, clouds)
        
        # Stickman
        stroke_width = 10
        color = BLACK
        fill_color = WHITE
        
        head = Circle(radius=0.8, color=color, fill_color=fill_color, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        
        eye_left = Dot(radius=0.1, color=color)
        eye_right = Dot(radius=0.1, color=color)
        eyes = VGroup(eye_left, eye_right)
        mouth = Arc(radius=0.3, start_angle=PI*1.1, angle=PI*0.8, color=color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        face = VGroup(eyes, mouth)
        
        body = Line(UP, DOWN*1.5, color=color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        
        arm_left = Line(UP, DOWN, color=color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        arm_right = Line(UP, DOWN, color=color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        leg_left = Line(UP, DOWN, color=color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        leg_right = Line(UP, DOWN, color=color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        
        stickman = VGroup(leg_left, arm_left, body, head, face, arm_right, leg_right)
        
        t_tracker = ValueTracker(0)
        smile_tracker = ValueTracker(0)
        blink_tracker = ValueTracker(1)
        
        blink_timer = [0.0]
        def blink_updater(mob, dt):
            blink_timer[0] += dt
            if blink_timer[0] > 2.5: # blink every 2.5 seconds
                mob.set_value(0)
                blink_timer[0] = 0
            elif mob.get_value() < 1:
                mob.set_value(min(1, mob.get_value() + dt * 8)) # restore to 1 fast
        blink_tracker.add_updater(blink_updater)
        
        def stickman_updater(mob):
            t = t_tracker.get_value()
            speed = 6
            phase = t * speed
            
            # Bobbing
            bob = np.abs(np.sin(phase)) * 0.25
            head_center = UP * 1.5 + DOWN * bob
            head.move_to(head_center)
            
            # Body
            body_start = head_center + DOWN * 0.8
            body_end = body_start + DOWN * 1.8
            body.put_start_and_end_on(body_start, body_end)
            
            shoulder = body_start + DOWN * 0.2
            hip = body_end
            
            # Legs
            stride = 1.0
            leg_length = 1.6
            left_foot_x = np.cos(phase) * stride
            left_foot_y = hip[1] - leg_length + max(0, -np.sin(phase)) * 0.5
            leg_left.put_start_and_end_on(hip, np.array([left_foot_x, left_foot_y, 0]))
            
            right_foot_x = np.cos(phase + PI) * stride
            right_foot_y = hip[1] - leg_length + max(0, -np.sin(phase + PI)) * 0.5
            leg_right.put_start_and_end_on(hip, np.array([right_foot_x, right_foot_y, 0]))
            
            # Arms (swing opposite to legs)
            arm_stride = 0.8
            arm_length = 1.3
            left_hand_x = np.cos(phase + PI) * arm_stride
            left_hand_y = shoulder[1] - arm_length + np.sin(phase + PI) * 0.1
            arm_left.put_start_and_end_on(shoulder, np.array([left_hand_x, left_hand_y, 0]))
            
            right_hand_x = np.cos(phase) * arm_stride
            right_hand_y = shoulder[1] - arm_length + np.sin(phase) * 0.1
            arm_right.put_start_and_end_on(shoulder, np.array([right_hand_x, right_hand_y, 0]))
            
            # Face
            face_center = head_center + RIGHT * 0.25
            eye_left_center = face_center + UP * 0.1 + LEFT * 0.2
            eye_right_center = face_center + UP * 0.1 + RIGHT * 0.2
            
            b = blink_tracker.get_value()
            if b < 0.2:
                eye_left.become(Line(eye_left_center + LEFT*0.1, eye_left_center + RIGHT*0.1, color=color, stroke_width=stroke_width))
                eye_right.become(Line(eye_right_center + LEFT*0.1, eye_right_center + RIGHT*0.1, color=color, stroke_width=stroke_width))
            else:
                eye_left.become(Dot(eye_left_center, radius=0.1*b, color=color))
                eye_right.become(Dot(eye_right_center, radius=0.1*b, color=color))
                
            # Mouth
            s = smile_tracker.get_value()
            mouth_center = face_center + DOWN * 0.25
            
            if s < 0.05:
                mouth.become(Arc(radius=0.25, start_angle=PI*1.1, angle=PI*0.8, color=color, stroke_width=stroke_width).move_to(mouth_center))
            else:
                laugh_height = 0.1 + 0.5 * s
                laugh_mouth = Sector(
                    outer_radius=0.25, 
                    angle=PI, 
                    start_angle=PI, 
                    color=color, 
                    fill_color=BLACK, 
                    fill_opacity=1
                ).scale([1, laugh_height/0.25, 1]).move_to(mouth_center + DOWN * (laugh_height/2))
                
                mouth.become(laugh_mouth)

        stickman.add_updater(stickman_updater)
        self.add(stickman)
        
        # Animation sequence
        self.play(t_tracker.animate.set_value(2), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
        
        self.play(
            t_tracker.animate.set_value(4),
            smile_tracker.animate.set_value(1),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=linear
        )
        
        self.play(t_tracker.animate.set_value(8), run_time=4, rate_func=linear)
